fusions.name: Under the Gorget
fusions.desc: A sting that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1 second, leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Every Joint Found
fusions.desc: Stings everything in a cone 4 tiles long. Each sting deals 26 damage that ignores armour, with a 40% chance to leave its target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Curled in the Shell
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Answered in Kind
fusions.desc: Every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10%, and 12% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.
